screen.title: Campus Bike Repair Day
text: Saturday, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., outside the Student Center. Volunteer mechanics will check brakes, adjust gears and fix flat tires at no cost. Replacement parts such as chains and lights are available at cost price. Bikes must be dropped off before noon to be ready the same day. Please remove baskets and child seats before you arrive.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To announce an event offering free bike check-ups
To sell new bicycles to students at a special discount
To recruit volunteer mechanics for the Student Center
To explain new parking rules for bicycles on campus

why.en: Main purpose (paraphrase): free repair service. B and C reuse words from the text (bikes, volunteer mechanics, Student Center) but distort the meaning.
why.tr: Ana amaç (parafraz): ücretsiz bakım hizmeti. B/C metindeki kelimeleri (bikes, volunteer mechanics, Student Center) kullanıp anlamı bozuyor.
why.es: Propósito principal (paráfrasis): un servicio gratuito de reparación. B y C reutilizan palabras del texto (bikes, volunteer mechanics, Student Center), pero deforman el significado.

questions.stem: What will most likely happen to a bike that is dropped off at 1 p.m.?
options: Its repairs will cost more than in the morning.
It may not be ready until a later day.
Its basket will be removed by the volunteers.
It will receive new parts at cost price.

why.en: Inference: bikes must be dropped off before noon "to be ready the same day", so a 1 p.m. bike may not be ready that day. A contradicts "at no cost"; C and D misuse details about baskets and parts.
why.tr: Çıkarım: bisikletler "aynı gün hazır olması için" öğleden önce bırakılmalı; 13.00'te bırakılan o gün hazır olmayabilir. A "ücretsiz" bilgisiyle çelişiyor; C ve D sepet ve parça ayrıntılarını yanlış kullanıyor.
why.es: Inferencia: las bicicletas deben dejarse antes del mediodía "to be ready the same day", así que una bicicleta dejada a la 1 p. m. quizá no esté lista ese día. A contradice "at no cost"; C y D usan mal detalles sobre cestas y piezas.
